title: Pradhan quits: What oppn can learn from CJP-led students protest
content: In a remarkable turn of events, student protests led to resignation of Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan, showcasing the power of grassroots activism. The Cockroach Janata Party, born from online memes, played a pivotal role in this uprising. Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike also fueled the movement's progress, raising critical questions for opposition parties regarding their involvement in such significant demonstrations.

title: Quashing of FIRs, compensation & 5-point Charter: What Centre, CJP said in joint press meet
content: The Cockroach Janta Party ended its 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar. This decision followed three rounds of talks with the central government delegation. The government accepted two key demands, including the minister's resignation. All legal cases filed against protesters and organizers will now be withdrawn. The party continues to pursue compensation for families affected by the NEET paper leak.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: India script history, equal world record for most 200-plus T20I totals in a year
content: India achieved their ninth 200-plus total in T20Is for 2026. This performance matches their own world record set previously in 2024. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the strong batting effort against Zimbabwe. They built crucial partnerships after an early batting collapse. India's batting continues to set new standards in the shortest format.

title: Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Union education minister amid massive student protests
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action comes amid ongoing protests concerning the NEET paper leak. The government has taken immediate cognizance of the irregularities. Investigations were handed over to the CBI, and the exam was cancelled.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: Pakistan's embarrassing blunder, field six players in five-a-side hockey game vs India
content: The incident took place on Friday shortly after the match began, when the umpires noticed Pakistan had six players on the field. Under the rules of the five-a-side format, only five players are allowed.

title: This AI data centre promised no Colorado River water. Now it wants 260mn gallons
content: Deemed as the largest AI data centre in the state, the 330-megawatt unit earlier promised to not use water from Colorado River. But now, the developer behind the project is suing for access to the river water which is already a threatened source of freshwater for 40 million people and the centre of countless disputes over water use in West.

title: After poaching erased wildlife, 12 giraffes may rescue this Uganda reserve
content: Uganda is moving endangered Nubian giraffes from Murchison Falls National Park to Ajai Wildlife Reserve. This relocation aims to protect the species from oil drilling and habitat pressures. Ajai Wildlife Reserve is undergoing ecological restoration and reintroduction of various animal species. Local communities are actively engaged and benefit from conservation efforts. The initiative seeks to foster coexistence between development and wildlife preservation.

title: Andrej Karpathy who coined Vibe Coding shares tips for writing better AI prompts
content: AI researcher Andrej Karpathy suggests users should ramble into AI chatbots.  He believes this approach provides more data for the AI to process effectively.  This method allows humans to quickly share all thoughts and nuances without strict phrasing.  The AI then organizes the chaotic monologue into clear and structured outputs.  This improves the AI's understanding and reduces the need for corrections.

title: Student leader to education minister: Dharmendra Pradhan's political career before NEET row
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post on Saturday. He submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi due to ongoing protests. Pradhan's tenure saw the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020. His political journey began in student politics in Odisha many years ago. He previously held key portfolios in the Union government since 2014.

title: Who is Yash Thakur? Vidarbha pacer making his India debut against Zimbabwe
content: The 27-year-old fast bowler from Vidarbha earned his maiden India cap after consistent performances in domestic cricket and for India A.

Dipke demanded compensation for families and action against police officers.  Pradhan accepted responsibility for the NEET paper leak controversy from the start.  Meanwhile, police dismissed rumors about a ban on food delivery services.

title: Shreyas Iyer's remarkable streak ends! India captain loses first T20I toss

Zimbabwe retained their unchanged playing eleven from the first match.

content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Several Bollywood celebrities reacted positively to the news on social media platforms. Pradhan stated he took responsibility for the situation and respected youth aspirations.

title: 'We won't go': CJP's Dipke says protests to continue till all demands met

Celebrations followed the minister's resignation at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.

title: 'To ensure anti-national elements don't ...': Pradhan resigns - read full letter
content: Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. title: 2-month probe, 3-month trial: Govt proposes sweeping changes to anti-cheating law
content: Under the proposed Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, investigations into offences under the Act will have to be completed within two months. The Bill empowers the Central Government to constitute a special fast track courts, wherever necessary, for investigation of offences under the Act. The amendment also proposes that trials in special fast track courts  be conducted on a day-to-day basis and completed within three months from the date of filing of the chargesheet.

title: Gambhir termed 'foolish' after ex-India selector's Sooryavanshi verdict

This performance followed his earlier inclusion and subsequent exclusion from the team. Former player Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticized the decision to drop him. Sooryavanshi's dedication and fearless approach were also highlighted.

title: Millions with desk jobs, millions with cervical pain
content: The rise of neck pain among young professionals in India can be attributed to the demands of desk jobs. Extended exposure to screens coupled with poor posture is leading to this unsettling health trend. Many individuals face daily discomfort that detracts from their quality of life and productivity. Medical experts report a concerning increase in younger patients. To combat this, implementing ergonomic solutions and promoting movement breaks is essential.

title: 'Arrest me if you want': Wangchuk alleges harassment; hospital clarifies

Hospital authorities stated the video was recorded before receiving the court's written order.  Wangchuk ended his hunger strike after receiving government assurances on his demands.  His protest focused on examination reforms and protecting peaceful demonstrators.

title: Bihar bandh: Tej Pratap Yadav detained as NEET protests intensify
content: A statewide bandh occurred in Bihar over the alleged NEET paper leak. Left-wing student groups organized protests and blocked roads in several districts. Authorities increased security measures and deployed additional police personnel across the state. Protesters demanded the resignation of the Union education minister for the alleged leak. The bandh followed earlier violent clashes and stone-pelting in Patna.

title: Ghost flats explained: Why some fully built homes remain empty despite India's housing shortage
content: In numerous Indian cities, a staggering number of finished apartments sit empty, transforming neighborhoods into ghost towns. Poor infrastructure and speculative investments keep these units unoccupied, frustrating the millions in search of affordable housing. This dilemma extends beyond India's borders, as countries worldwide grapple with similar housing market issues. Devoted constructors and investors often neglect the need for actual living spaces in their focus on profit and development.

title: 'Cops everywhere': Wangchuk's wife Gitanjali claims he's under constant police vigil

title: How Patrick Mahomes turned family support and adversity into NFL greatness
content: Patrick Mahomes says his greatest strength is not just football but the support of his family. From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: 'Sack Pradhan from Cabinet': Rahul says ministerial reshuffle won't quell protest

title: India's para cyclist Lisha Das rejects federation's support, opts for own kit and flag
content: minor para cyclist Lisha Das escalated her dispute with the country's sports authorities ahead of her departure for the Commonwealth Games . she said she would stay outside the team hotel, travel on independently booked tickets and decline the federation’s travel and accommodation arrangements in Glasgow . the athlete demanded immediate accreditation and field-of-play access for her coach, Aditya Mehta, saying the Delhi high court recognised him as her coach .
